[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Bob's capture language reads as three rules: @ says where, # names [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]a place or a type, and % says how. `Text @note+id#drawer \[#type]` [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]files a note in a task drawer, creating the drawer when it is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]missing and optionally retyping the task in the same transaction. [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`%c`, `%n`, `%t`, and `%l` replace trailing `#`, `%`, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`@@template:`, and `URL %`. Typing `#`, `%`, or `@note+id#` in Bob [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Mac Capture opens a bob-described menu with nothing preselected. [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every retired form is deleted outright, with no aliases.[/#D7D7AF]
